Kaya - Design: dropping a short review for the version-history scrubber + revert flow. Two goals: keep compact timeline scannable, and make revert feel low-risk. Figma: https://figma.com/file/versions-scrubber (tiny mock).

Ben (ENG): From an impl POV, scrubber needs to stay tabbable. When compact we can collapse long labels to "v42" and expose full name on focus via aria-describedby. Avoid extra network calls for hover.

Rae (a11y): Accessibility checklist: 1) Scrubber is role="slider" with aria-valuetext like "Version v42, deployed 3 days ago". 2) Revert modal is role="alertdialog" and uses aria-modal="true". 3) Add aria-live polite for start/complete announcements: "Reverted to v42. Traffic at 100 percent."

Ibrahim (SRE): UX ask: show a tiny snapshot diff inline under the scrubber when expanded. Limit to first 200 chars and show "view full diff" link. Also show whether the version had database migrations (important for rollback risk).

Kaya - Design: Copy tweak: current CTA text "Rollback" is scaring folks. Proposal A: "Revert to last stable". Proposal B: "Switch back to v42". We'll A/B test in the console. Modal body should include reassurance line: "No user data will be deleted."

Ben (ENG): We'll add data-experiment="revert_cta_copy" to the modal so product can flip text client-side. Also will emit analytics events: "revert_shown" "revert_confirmed" with fields {version, copy_variant}.

Rae (a11y): Minor but important: don't rely on color to indicate risky vs safe. Add textual badges like "(Canary)" or "(Live)" and ensure contrast ratio for badges is >=4.5:1. Also make sure ESC closes modal and returns focus to the scrubber thumb.

Ibrahim (SRE): Edge case: cross-region reverts. If a version wasn't deployed everywhere, modal should warn: "This will revert regions: us-west, eu-central. Some regions may remain on newer builds." Link to audit log.

Kaya - Design: small interaction note: when user drags scrubber and pauses for >1s show a non-modal preview panel (role="dialog" but not modal) with snapshot info; make it dismissible with ESC and focus trap avoided.

Kaya - Design: Action items: I'll update mock to include snapshot preview and explicit "No user data will be deleted" copy; Ben to add experiment flag wiring and keyboard focus behavior; Rae to write a 5-item a11y acceptance checklist; Ibrahim to prototype snapshot truncation rules and region warnings. Planning a 20m demo next Tue. :calendar:
